comparison.objective: Clear a carton jammed askew at narrowing conveyor guides, versus tune and lock an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Diagnose wedging and apply force-limited translation/rotation to extract or realign a carton versus recessed-tool insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Restored conveyor path without carton/guide damage is title-implied; no body/specs or force/clearance thresholds are supplied. Candidate validates repeated impact absorption and lock stability.
comparison.reason: Jam clearance tests safe de-wedging and object recovery, not continuous mechanical adjustment.
